title: David Vlijmincx
subtitle: David Vlijmincx — Java Performance & Concurrency Specialist, Oracle ACE, and International Speaker. Deep-dive engineering research and enterprise workshops on Virtual Threads, Project Panama (FFM API), Linux io_uring, and Modern Java.

posts.title: Hidden Costs of Java Virtual Threads: GC & Cache Locality
posts.description: What happens when Java Virtual Threads are misused: stack copying to the heap, OutOfMemoryErrors, GC pressure, and CPU cache locality.

posts.title: Thread-Safe Native Memory in Java: VarHandle Modes

posts.title: Native Memory in Java: Arenas, Malloc & Custom Pools
